game.title: Battlefield V
game.blurb: World War II first-person shooter from Electronic Arts DICE (with Electronic Arts and Uprise, as RAWG lists them), released 2018-11-20. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1238810)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Battlefield_V
Fandom (battlefield.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://battlefield.fandom.com/wiki/Battlefield_V
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 1238810 ("Battlefield™ V") was the only app-list match; the Steam schema names it "Battlefield ™ V". RAWG's first search result matched the expected slug. None of the 21 Steam achievements is hidden. Only three War Stories are named by achievements (Under No Flag, Nordlys, Tirailleur); RAWG's description mentions war stories but the data does not list any others, so the chapter covers just those three. Most achievements are multiplayer. StrategyWiki has "Battlefield V" at completion stage 0, marked as a stub; its Gameplay, Walkthrough, Table of Contents and Custom Nav subpages are linked but not written, so nothing was used. battlefield.fandom.com answers the API under "Battlefield V" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
